functionality.rationale: A false milestone acceptance would mark the one-file vertical slice complete without real two-process evidence.

security.rationale: Acceptance must prove authenticated peer identity, hostile-peer rejection, and cleanup rather than only successful transfer.

performance.rationale: The vertical slice must complete without unbounded queues or memory, while production throughput baselines remain later work.

compatibility.rationale: Two real processes and available cross-platform pairs must interoperate through the accepted ABI and wire profile.

concurrency.rationale: Cancellation, process exit, callbacks, and artifact cleanup must remain deterministic end to end.

platform.rationale: The milestone covers packaged macOS, Windows, and Linux applications rather than one host build.

persistence.rationale: Acceptance must confirm committed files survive and failed transfers leave no temporary artifacts.

adr.rationale: The task accepts evidence against existing ADRs and introduces no new decision.

architecture.rationale: Durable documentation must replace scaffold claims with accepted vertical-slice behavior and test coverage.

roadmap.rationale: The task closes only the evidenced P1 vertical-slice checklist.
